rules.C6: at most 0.10 of the drawn slates of a judged cell at L5 or L6
rules.C1: |rate - 0.5| <= 3 sqrt(0.25 / n) per cell and rate; pooled |rate - 0.5| <= 0.01 (v4, amendment 1)
rules.C2 and N1 to N6: c + 0.02 + 2 sqrt(c(1-c)/n) (N6: c the none share, n the slates answered none)
